main_findings: Existing-object read/write witnesses are not a universal semantic freshness model; negative predicates/phantoms require predicate/range/invariant witnesses.
Runtime observed dependency traces may narrow a trusted compiler-derived static envelope, but observed-only validation is unsafe if interposition can be escaped.
Temporal/environment/workspace-regime dependencies must be explicit when they influence operation semantics.
Irreversible external effects require pre-effect authority interposition and are best staged as durable idempotent effect intents rather than treated as rollbackable speculative calls.
CC-RC1.3 refines CC-RC1.2; it does not refute the surviving CC7 principles of semantic IR, state-root identity, op semantics hash and external authority.
